text.p: Italian bonds and Btp futures ended the session lower with some traders attributing the downturn to comments on EMU by Bundesbank president Hans Tietmeyer while others said it was just a technical correction after the June contract peaked at 129.05 in the morning.
The June Btp Liffe contract closed 15 basis points off at 128.37 after an afternoon low of 128.13.

"The Italian market eased for technical reasons," one trader said. "Operators wanted to see if the future managed to break a target just above 129, but when they saw this wasn't on there was selling and profit-taking."
